story.text: St. John is going to India as a {MISSIONARY}. He asks Jane to {MARRY} him and come too, not for love, but because she would make a useful {WIFE}. She will go, but only as his {SISTER}. He is cold and {RELENTLESS}, and she nearly {SUBMITS}, until one night she hears a voice crying across the moor: “Jane! Jane! Jane!”
story.caption: He threw himself down on a swell of heath, and there lay still
